title: Open-source mechanism harvesting for full-machine completion
statement: Use lawful open-source software, repositories, algorithms, public technical information, standards, papers and reusable mechanisms as the default engineering supply chain before original construction while completing the currently achievable GREG Body + Organs + Mind. Invent only the residual capability that qualified reuse, adaptation and composition cannot supply.
intended_outcome: Increase engineering velocity and capability breadth by metabolizing existing lawful open-source work into governed GREG capabilities without narrowing the full-machine destination, duplicating authority, or laundering unqualified code into production.
rationale: Current doctrine already says acquire before invent, but the founder explicitly broadened open-source-first from cost substitution into a project-wide construction strategy: search, qualify, reuse and recombine existing mechanisms before writing solved technology again.
conflicts: Upstream licenses, notice obligations, patents, security posture, privacy requirements and distribution terms remain external constraints.
Educational or example repositories cannot be treated as production-qualified merely because they are open source.
Repository-scale imports may conflict with one canonical Kernel, registry, mission path or learning plane and must be adapted behind existing interfaces.
owner: Alfonso Lopez; repository maintainers and coding agents implement within existing authority
next_review_trigger: Any material CapabilityDeficit, repository-scale import, license/security change, upstream abandonment, or evidence that search and qualification cost exceeds the engineering value of reuse for a capability class.
unresolved_questions: Which open-source mechanism family should be the first post-seed repertoire expansion after the current embodied-mission gate clears?
Which third-party components require professional license or patent review before redistribution?
